description: Soft-delete an existing test case in the connected product. TWO-STEP CONFIRM: call once with just `tcId` to preview the target (title + step count) and get a warning; then call again with `{ tcId, confirm: true }` to actually delete. Refuses to delete without `confirm:true`. `tcId` accepts the product's id or business key. Requires a live connection (qa_connect). Product-neutral.

confirm.description: Set to true on the SECOND call to actually delete.

tcId.description: The test case id (or business key) to delete.

name: tc_delete
title: Delete a test case (two-step confirm)
